question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Wet winters and hot, dry sumers tend to create better quality wine.
solution:
**The correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'sumers'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'summers'.**
 
• The word '**summers**' refers to the warmest season of the year, occurring between spring and autumn. **(गर्मियां)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• We usually go to the beach during the **summers**.
 
 
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer is 'sumers'.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Winters -** the coldest season of the year, occurring between autumn and spring **(सर्दियां)**
 
• **Create - **bring (something) into existence **(बनाना)**
 
• **Quality -** the standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something **(गुणवत्ता)**
